Does TradeHQ recommend buying Shiba Inu?

No. TradeHQ is an educational simulator and does not rate assets as good or bad investments. Use the page to understand SHIB price drivers and to test a process with virtual funds.

How can a beginner practise trading SHIB?

Start by learning what tends to move SHIB, then use virtual funds to practise order types, position sizing, predefined exits, and post-trade review. Treat any risk percentage as a simulation setting rather than a universal rule.

What affects SHIB price?

SHIB price is influenced by market sentiment, regulatory news, network metrics, and Bitcoin correlation.
